title: CI toolchain selected by mutable branch name from .odin-version, not a pinned commit SHA
detail: Every CI gate compiles against whatever the branch name resolves to; branch re-points or force-pushes silently change the toolchain and the blessed baseline. The pin is currently an invalid upstream branch (known); when fixed, branch selection remains wrong.
recommended_fix: Pin an immutable commit SHA (or signed tag) in .odin-version and clone by it; verify the SHA exists upstream. Mutable branch names must never select the toolchain.

title: Committed 2 MB app.bin executable with no provenance tying it to source
evidence:
chunk-6-misc.patch:
diff --git a/app.bin b/app.bin
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..4aaf130
Binary files /dev/null and b/app.bin differ
(git ls-files confirms tracked at the reviewed sha; 2057480 bytes)
detail: An executable binary is committed while CI rebuilds app from source separately; nothing verifies the committed bytes match the reviewed source, so a stale or tampered binary ships silently and review cannot audit it.
recommended_fix: Remove app.bin from the repo and gitignore it; CI's `odin build app` already produces the artifact from reviewed source. Re-add only with a deliberate, documented provenance process.
